title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 41
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 41: the temple measured inside, the side rooms, and the cherubim and palm trees on the walls.

questions.text: How wide were the posts that he measured at the temple, on each side?
questions.explanation: He measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side.

questions.text: What was the width of the entrance of the temple?
questions.explanation: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on each side.

questions.text: What did the man call the room that measured twenty cubits by twenty cubits?
questions.explanation: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the temple, and said, "This is the most holy place."

answers.text: The holy rooms of the priests

questions.text: How wide was every side room around the house?
questions.explanation: He measured the wall of the house, six cubits, and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house.

questions.text: In how many stories were the side rooms, and how many were there in order?
questions.explanation: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in order.

questions.text: How thick was the wall for the side rooms on the outside?
questions.explanation: The thickness of the wall which was for the side rooms, on the outside, was five cubits.

questions.text: What were the width and length of the building before the separate place toward the west?
questions.explanation: The building before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide, and its length ninety cubits.

answers.text: Fifty cubits wide and one hundred long
One hundred wide and one hundred long
Twenty cubits wide and thirty long
Seventy cubits wide and ninety long

questions.text: Which two faces did every cherub have?
questions.explanation: A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces: the face of a man on one side and the face of a young lion on the other.

answers.text: A man's face and an eagle's face
An ox's face and an eagle's face
A man's face and a young lion's face
A lion's face and an ox's face

questions.text: Of what was the altar made, and how high was it?
questions.explanation: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits, and he said, "This is the table that is before Yahweh."

answers.text: Of cut stone, four cubits high

questions.text: How many doors did the temple and the sanctuary have, and how many leaves had each door?
questions.explanation: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors, and the doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves.

answers.text: Three doors, with two leaves each
Four doors, with three leaves each
Two doors, with two leaves each
